description: This file defines a class EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM PIM module, used to specify filtering parameters for searching employee immigration records. The class extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as empNumber and number, with associated getter and setter methods. It also defines allowed sort fields and sets a default sort field upon instantiation.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering employee immigration record searches, specifically handling employee number and record number, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the default sort field to 'eir.number'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the immigration record number if set.

methods.name: setNumber
methods.description: Sets the immigration record number filter criterion.
